channel.title: GQ US (Conde Nast) - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from GQ US (Conde Nast) (gq.com)

item.title: Exclusive: The Jay-Z Interview
item.description: In a rare interview, Jay-Z puts everything on the table—business, family and 30 years of music.

item.title: Will Welch on What He Learned from Jay-Z
item.description: In his final editor's note as the global editorial director of GQ, Welch shares how seven words from a music mogul helped to guide his personal development—and his eight years at GQ's helm.

item.title: Rashid Johnson, the Artist Who Shot Jay-Z’s GQ Cover, Drew Inspiration From the Harlem Renaissance
item.description: For our April issue, Johnson turns his lens to an indelible 21st-century Black thinker: Jay-Z. “Jay’s stories are about his life, his own growth and development,” the artist says. “In a lot of ways, they’re quite existential.”

item.title: The Real-Life Diet of Joakim Noah, Who Once Put on 10 Pounds of Muscle in One Summer
item.description: Now that he’s no longer jostling for rebounds or clapping in opponents’ faces, the NBA dignitary (and two-time NCAA champion) is finding time for swimming, protein coffee, and mental health work.

item.title: Of Course L.L.Bean's Japanese Line Is Already Selling Out
item.description: The American brand's rarest sub-label just returned to the States, and people are losing their minds.

item.title: HBO’s ‘Harry Potter’ Cast Has Assembled, and Production Is Underway. Here’s Everything We Know
item.description: As cameras roll on the all-new ‘Harry Potter’ adaptation, HBO has revealed the first image of Dominic McLaughlin's Harry on set.

item.title: Even Sombr’s Off-Duty Style Is Straight Out of the ’70s
item.description: The 20-year-old musician dressed up in a tight retro tee and high-waisted bell-bottoms for a trip to the farmers market.

item.title: I’m Glad That Men’s Knitwear Is Twee Now
item.description: For a while, guys were big into grizzled fisherman sweaters. Now, thanks to co-signs from Andrew Garfield and Josh O’Connor, crewnecks are feeling a little more bucolic.

item.title: The Best Movie Fight Scenes, Definitively Ranked
item.description: From ‘Rocky’ and ‘Raging Bull’ to the bathroom brawl in ‘Mission: Impossible—Fallout’, these are the scrappiest, grittiest fight scenes ever filmed.

item.title: Inside Jay-Z’s World-Class Watch Collection
item.description: A closer look at the six holy grail timepieces Hov brought along to his GQ cover shoot.

item.title: This Tom Cruise/Steven Spielberg Blockbuster Is Still Somehow Underrated
item.description: The EGOT director and the President of Movies are both about to have a banner year. GQ columnist Frazier Tharpe runs back a 2000s Spielberg/Cruise classic that doesn't get enough credit.

item.title: 8 Reasons Longines Is the 20th Century’s Most Underrated Watch Brand
item.description: 'Longines: Watches That Made History' makes a strong case for adding the historic watchmaker to your wrist.

item.title: Ian Tuason on the Films, Filmmakers, and Creepypastas That Influenced ‘Undertone’
item.description: The writer-director reveals the inspirations for his unique new horror film, from Slender Man to Stanley Kubrick.

item.title: Citizen's Flagship Dive Watch Is on a Whale of a Sale
item.description: You can't afford not to cop this do-it-all diver at its current price during Amazon's Big Spring Sale.

item.title: Do Sauna Blankets Actually Work?
item.description: What can the trendy wellness accessory do for your recovery and skin? Experts say research on the manner is a hot mess.
